_readme: Index of every dataset in data/. Written by scripts/build_catalog.py. provenance: pipeline = fetched by scripts/fetch.py on a schedule; script = written by another script, run by hand; manual = pulled by hand, cannot self-refresh; unattributed = nothing claims it, treat with suspicion.

datasets.source: Stanford AI Index via Our World in Data: world corporate investment in AI by deal type, annual
datasets.note: World totals only. The merger/acquisition line is lumpy: one large deal moves a year. OWID publishes plain dollars; stored here in billions

datasets.source: Stanford AI Index (Quid data) via Our World in Data: private investment in AI companies by region, annual
datasets.note: Private investment means venture and private equity deals, not corporate spending on chips and data centres, so hyperscaler capital expenditure is not in it. Europe is Quid's region, not the EU. Nominal US dollars; the 2025 figure is a partial-year count. OWID publishes plain dollars; stored here in billions

datasets.source: Epoch AI via Our World in Data: cumulative number of large-scale AI systems (training compute above 10^23 FLOP) by the country of the developing organisation, annual
datasets.note: Cumulative counts, so every line only rises. Country is where the organisation is based; a model trained by a multinational team is under Multinational. Epoch's catalogue is curated, not exhaustive

datasets.source: World Bank World Development Indicators via the World Bank API, annual, 20 Asian and Middle Eastern economies plus Türkiye: growth, GDP per capita PPP (constant 2021 international $), GDP in USD billions, CPI inflation, unemployment (ILO modelled), population in millions, exports, manufacturing and agriculture value added as % of GDP, FDI inflows % of GDP, gross capital formation % of GDP, urban share, energy use per capita, R&D % of GDP, high-tech exports % of manufactured exports
datasets.note: Series keys are country|indicator. WDI revises history and lags one to two years; the latest year for a country is often missing for slow indicators (energy, R&D). Taiwan is not a World Bank member and returns nothing for most indicators
datasets.unit: varies by indicator; the series id names the World Bank code

datasets.source: The Economist Big Mac index — raw valuation vs the euro (0 = burger costs the same as in the euro area; +0.10 = 10% dearer)
datasets.note: Same file as bigmac-usd, euro-relative column; fractions, not percent.
datasets.unit: fraction, not percent: -0.17 means a Big Mac is 17% cheaper than in the euro area, +0.28 means 28% dearer. Multiply by 100 before quoting a percentage.

datasets.source: The Economist Big Mac index SOURCE data — euro-denominated prices: individual euro members (from 2011-07) plus the EUZ weighted average, in EUR
datasets.note: Member prices are The Economist's collected source prices, not headline index rows; parity vs the euro area = member price / EUZ price - 1, computed per edition on the page.

datasets.source: The Economist Big Mac index (open data, github.com/TheEconomist/big-mac-data) — Big Mac price converted to USD at market rates
datasets.note: Semi-annual (Jan+Jul), 2000->today; a one-item price level, current within ~6 months — the timeliness complement to Eurostat PPP (annual, ~18-month lag). One burger is not a consumption basket.

datasets.source: Eurostat sts_inppd_m, Poland: producer prices for C1012 (poultry meat) and C1091 (prepared feeds), monthly
datasets.unit: parity = chicken-meat PPI over feed PPI; the two indices are 2015 = 100

datasets.source: EC agri-food data portal: young bulls R3 EU avg (EUR/100kg) + feed grain MS avg (EUR/t), monthly means of weekly quotes
Israel CBS index API: beef fresh PPI (id 180073) / agricultural input fodder index (id 180195), chained to the newest base across CBS rebasings
datasets.note: robustness pair, TR-parallel: 180073 processing & preserving of meat / 180195 prepared animal feeds — never merged into cattle-parity.json

units.beef_ppi: price index, chained to the latest CBS base
units.fodder_idx: price index, chained to the latest CBS base

datasets.source: Israel CBS index API: beef fresh PPI (id 190030) / agricultural input fodder index (id 260030), chained to the newest base across CBS rebasings

units.beef_ppi: price index, chained to the latest CBS base
units.fodder_idx: price index, chained to the latest CBS base

datasets.source: FRED/BLS (US), EC agri-food data portal (EU), TCMB EVDS (TR), Israel CBS (IL): meat and feed price indices, monthly
datasets.unit: index, 2016 = 100 (meat price over feed price, and the two indices behind it)

datasets.source: TCMB EVDS / TÜİK Yİ-ÜFE: TP.TUFE1YI.T17 (korunmuş et ve et ürünleri), TP.TUFE1YI.T25 (hazır hayvan yemleri)
FRED/BLS producer price indexes: WPU0131 (slaughter cattle), WPU012202 (corn)
Federal Reserve H.4.1, ECB and Bank of Japan balance sheets via FRED: WALCL, ECBASSETSW, JPNASSETS, WRESBAL, M2SL, CURRCIR
datasets.note: Different currencies and units: the Fed and ECB in millions of their own currency, the Bank of Japan in hundred millions of yen, US M2 and currency in billions. Compare shapes or rebase, never levels across banks. The Fed and ECB publish weekly; this file keeps the last observation of each month so everything is monthly

datasets.source: Eurostat Comext DS-045409, exports to world, EUR, by HS chapter: 28 inorganic chemicals, 29 organic chemicals, 38 miscellaneous chemical products, 84 machinery, 85 electrical machinery and electronics, 87 vehicles, 90 optical, measuring and medical instruments
datasets.note: Customs values; intra-EU flows included in 'world'. Türkiye is not a Comext reporter

datasets.source: Atmospheric CO2 concentration (ppm), long-term - Our World in Data grapher co2-long-term-concentration
datasets.note: Annual. Run MODE=discover first if the slug or entity name has drifted.

datasets.source: Global mean temperature anomaly (deg C vs 1861-1890) - Our World in Data grapher temperature-anomaly
datasets.note: Annual. Grapher entity may be 'Global' or 'World' depending on vintage - both mapped; keep whichever returns data.

datasets.source: Energy Institute Statistical Review via Our World in Data: coal production by country, annual, terawatt-hours
datasets.note: TWh of energy content, so lignite (most of Türkiye's coal) counts for less than its tonnage suggests

datasets.source: FRED/BLS WPU0131 and WPU012202 (US), EC agri-food data portal (EU), monthly
datasets.note: denominator = maize/corn everywhere (robustness check)

datasets.source: Eurostat prc_hicp_minr — HICP all items (ECOICOP2), monthly index, 2015=100
datasets.note: Feeds the cost-escalation tool's CPI factor. Successor of prc_hicp_midx, which was archived at 2025-12 with the 2026 rebase (ECOICOP2, coicop18 dimension, all-items code TOTAL). meat-cpi-eu kept as the frozen pre-rebase file for the meat post and basket explorer.

datasets.source: ECB Survey of Professional Forecasters, scored against ECB HICP outturns
datasets.note: Forecasters are anonymous; the ECB publishes them only by number and this makes no attempt to identify them.
datasets.unit: score and rank per forecaster; see the note for the construction

datasets.source: ECB Survey of Professional Forecasters, and ECB HICP
datasets.note: Individual forecaster probability distributions over euro-area inflation, by target year and survey round, published openly by the ECB. The top bucket is open-ended at 4.0% or more.
datasets.unit: probability, percent, that euro-area inflation falls in the bucket; actual_hicp in percent

datasets.source: Eurostat nrg_pc_205 — electricity, non-household band IC (500–1 999 MWh), excl. recoverable taxes, national currency per kWh, semi-annual
datasets.note: Escalation tool: mid-size industrial benchmark band, published since 2007. NAC on purpose — FX is its own factor.
datasets.unit: national currency per kWh, excluding recoverable taxes

datasets.source: Ember Yearly Electricity Data and the Energy Institute Statistical Review, via Our World in Data: electricity generated by source, TWh, annual
datasets.note: Series keys are country|source. Generation, not capacity and not consumption: a country that imports power shows less here than it uses. Coal, gas and oil start in 1985 for most countries; the renewables and nuclear columns reach back to 1965. The last year is often Ember's provisional figure

datasets.source: Eurostat nrg_pc_204 — electricity prices for household consumers, band DC (2 500–4 999 kWh a year), all taxes and levies included, euro per kWh, semi-annual from 2007
datasets.note: What a household actually pays, as against the industrial bands in elec-eu and gas-eu. Taxes included on purpose: the tax wedge is most of what separates one country from another. Euro rather than national currency, so the countries are directly comparable and an exchange-rate move shows up in the price.
datasets.unit: EUR per kWh, all taxes included

datasets.source: Daily and weekly energy spot prices via FRED: Brent (DCOILBRENTEU) and WTI (DCOILWTICO) crude in USD per barrel, Henry Hub natural gas (DHHNGSP) in USD per million BTU, and US average retail regular gasoline (GASREGW) and diesel (GASDESW) in USD per gallon
datasets.note: The current price, as against the monthly benchmarks in wb-commodities. Crude and Henry Hub gas are daily from 1986, 1987 and 1997; the two pump prices are weekly from 1990 and 1994. Full dates are kept, so these are the actual quotes rather than a month-end snapshot — resample with frequency='annual_mean' before mixing them with monthly or annual data. Nominal USD, not seasonally adjusted, and the pump prices include federal and state taxes while the crude and gas quotes do not.

datasets.source: Eurostat avia_paoc: passengers carried, all schedules, by reporting country and coverage (total, international, national), monthly
datasets.note: Series keys are country|coverage. Passengers carried counts each passenger once per flight stage at the reporting country's airports; a Frankfurt–Istanbul passenger appears in both Germany's and Türkiye's totals. Türkiye reports from 2017. Not seasonally adjusted: compare a month with the same month a year earlier

datasets.source: Eurostat rd_e_berdindr2 business enterprise R&D expenditure, million EUR, annual: manufacturing (C), chemicals (C20), pharma (C21), computer and electronic (C26), electrical equipment (C27), machinery (C28)
datasets.note: Biennial for some countries; latest year is often provisional. Pharma BERD is the closest public proxy for biotech R&D

datasets.source: Eurostat road_eqr_carpda: new passenger car registrations by motor energy, annual
datasets.note: Series keys are country|fuel: TOTAL all fuels, PET petrol, DIE diesel, ELC battery electric, ELC_PET_HYB petrol hybrid, ELC_PET_PI plug-in petrol hybrid. Divide ELC by TOTAL for the electric share. The hybrid split exists only from 2017 and some countries report it late; the UK stops after 2019

datasets.source: European Commission business and consumer surveys via Eurostat ei_bssi_m_r2, seasonally adjusted, monthly: economic sentiment indicator (long-run mean 100), industrial, consumer and services confidence balances
datasets.note: ESI is an index around 100; the confidence indicators are percentage balances around zero. Türkiye is covered by the EC survey programme

datasets.source: Eurostat national accounts A*64, gross value added at current prices, million EUR: chemicals (C20), computer and electronic (C26), electrical equipment (C27), machinery (C28), motor vehicles (C29)
datasets.note: Current prices in EUR, so cross-country levels carry exchange-rate effects; pharma (C21) is in pharma-gva-eur

datasets.source: Euro area HICP via FRED — deflator for any EUR money series
Eurostat house price index prc_hpi_q, all purchases, quarterly index 2015=100
datasets.note: Nominal. Coverage starts later for some countries; Türkiye house prices are in tr-house-prices from TCMB

datasets.source: Eurostat sts_inpr_m industrial production, seasonally and calendar adjusted, 2021=100, monthly: manufacturing (C), chemicals (C20), pharma (C21), computer and electronic (C26), electrical equipment (C27), machinery (C28), motor vehicles (C29)
datasets.note: Volume indices. Sector detail is missing for some smaller countries; empty combinations are dropped

datasets.source: Eurostat sts_inpr_m: production in industry, seasonally and calendar adjusted, 2021 = 100, monthly: mining and quarrying (B), oil and gas extraction (B06), metal ores (B07), other mining and quarrying (B08), basic metals (C24)
datasets.note: Series keys are country|activity. Volume indices, 2021 = 100. The oil-and-gas and metal-ore lines exist only for countries that have them (Norway, Sweden, Poland, Türkiye); empty combinations are dropped

datasets.source: Eurostat sts_inppd_m domestic producer prices, unadjusted, 2021=100, monthly: chemicals (C20), computer and electronic (C26), electrical equipment (C27), machinery (C28), motor vehicles (C29)
datasets.note: Pharma (C21) and total manufacturing are in ppi-eu

datasets.source: Eurostat purchasing power parities and price level indices (prc_ppp_ind)
datasets.note: Codes pinned from MODE=discover run 2026-08-19. All 55 geos kept (incl. EU/EA aggregates, UK, US, JP, TR, Western Balkans). No veterinary/pharma category exists in this dataset — lowest health detail is A0106/A010603. COICOP 2018 rebase: category-level series may be short or broken around 2021/22 — check spans before charting.
datasets.unit: price level index, EU27 = 100, and PPP conversion factors

datasets.source: Eurostat nrg_ind_ren: share of energy from renewable sources, the official figure behind the EU targets, annual since 2004
datasets.note: Series keys are country|measure: REN overall (gross final energy consumption), REN_ELC electricity, REN_TRA transport, REN_HEAT_CL heating and cooling. The Renewable Energy Directive's accounting rules, so the electricity share differs from Ember's generation share in renewables-share. Türkiye is not in this table

datasets.source: Eurostat tour_occ_nim: nights spent at hotels, holiday and short-stay accommodation and campsites, by residents and foreign visitors, monthly
datasets.note: Series keys are country|residence: TOTAL, FOR foreign visitors, DOM residents. Nights, not arrivals, and only in registered accommodation: short-term rentals are largely outside it. Türkiye reports from 2018. Strong seasonality: compare year on year or use annual sums

datasets.source: Eurostat EAA veterinary expenses by member state, million EUR, ALL livestock
datasets.note: all livestock, not cattle only

datasets.source: Eurostat Economic Accounts for Agriculture, veterinary expenses
datasets.note: ALL livestock, not cattle only — do not present as a per-cattle figure without saying so

datasets.source: Eurostat SBS annual detailed enterprise statistics for services, veterinary activities (NACE M75)
datasets.note: Codes pinned from discover 2026-08-20: V11110 enterprises, V12110 turnover (M EUR), V12150 value added (M EUR), V16110 persons employed, V91100 turnover per person employed (k EUR). 39 geos. Legacy SBS series — check the fetched span; 2021+ lives in the successor EBS dataset (separate hunt).
datasets.unit: as published by Eurostat SBS; check the series id for the variable

datasets.source: Eurostat HICP item weights — share of veterinary and pet services in each country's consumption basket
datasets.note: HICP item weights, per-mille of total basket: CP0934 pets and related products, CP0935 veterinary and other services for pets. Dataset serves no 2026 (checked in discover — ECOICOP2 rebase); weights for 2026+ need the successor dataset once Eurostat publishes it. A stored 0 means the country did not collect that item's weight in that year (Kosovo throughout, Iceland to 2021), not a zero share
datasets.unit: per mille of the consumption basket

datasets.source: Natural Earth 110m admin-0 countries (public domain), filtered to Europe, coordinates rounded
datasets.note: Selector map for the escalation dashboard. ISO_A2_EH property (plain ISO_A2 is -99 for FR/NO in NE). GR→EL translated client-side.

datasets.source: Eurostat HICP monthly index (2015=100), all food classes CP0111-CP0122 plus CP011 food and CP00 all items, since Dec 2016
datasets.note: Feeds the Food Basket Explorer. Ratio metric (class ÷ CP011) computed client-side; sinceTimePeriod trims payload for page load.

datasets.source: FiveThirtyEight, 'How Good Are FiveThirtyEight Forecasts?'
datasets.note: 538's own published forecast record. ABC News shut the site down in March 2025 and took it offline; this GitHub archive is what survived.

Sufficient statistics for the slices the headline excludes, so the robustness table reproduces without the 350MB archive. bins are 20 equal-width probability bins, each [count, sum_of_forecast, sum_of_outcome].

datasets.source: Eurostat ert_bil_eur_m — monthly average exchange rates, national currency per euro
datasets.note: Feeds the cost-escalation tool. BGN not published monthly (currency-board peg to EUR) — noted in the tool.

datasets.source: Eurostat ert_bil_eur_a — annual average exchange rates, national currency per euro
datasets.note: used only to express absolute pharma value added in a common currency; every share ratio stays in national currency

datasets.source: Eurostat nrg_pc_203 — natural gas, non-household band I3 (10 000–99 999 GJ), excl. recoverable taxes, national currency per GJ, semi-annual
datasets.note: Escalation tool: mid-size industrial benchmark band. Countries without gas networks legitimately absent.
datasets.unit: national currency per gigajoule, excluding recoverable taxes

datasets.source: Eurostat nrg_pc_202 — natural gas prices for household consumers, band D2 (20–199 GJ a year), all taxes and levies included, euro per gigajoule, semi-annual from 2007
datasets.note: The household counterpart to gas-eu, which is the industrial band. Taxes included. Countries with no gas network are legitimately absent rather than missing.
datasets.unit: EUR per gigajoule, all taxes included

datasets.source: Energy Institute Statistical Review via Our World in Data: natural gas production by country, annual, terawatt-hours
datasets.note: TWh of energy content; 1 TWh is roughly 0.1 billion cubic metres. Türkiye's Black Sea field (Sakarya) starts to show from 2023; the last year lags by one

datasets.source: Eurostat national accounts — GDP at market prices, current prices, million EUR
datasets.note: for comparing economy SIZE across countries only; never use for the share ratio

datasets.source: Eurostat national accounts — GDP at market prices, current prices, million national currency
datasets.note: same vintage and currency basis as pharma-gva, so the ratio is internally consistent

datasets.source: Company filings (10-Q, 8-K), company releases, regulatory announcements and industry landscape reviews, Dec 2025 – Aug 2026
Yahoo Finance monthly adjusted closes, US listings/ADRs (USD); ^GSPC = S&P 500 index, XBI = SPDR biotech ETF benchmark
datasets.note: Adjusted close = split- and dividend-adjusted (total return); index SPX is raw level. ADRs (NVO, AZN, RHHBY, ZLDPF) embed FX moves. Metsera (MTSR) excluded: acquired by Pfizer Nov 2025, delisted — survivorship caveat. Zealand only trades OTC in the US (ZLDPF, thin); primary listing is Copenhagen.
datasets.unit: USD per share, except ^GSPC and XBI which are index points

datasets.source: Company fundamentals and consensus estimates via Bigdata.com
datasets.note: Trailing multiples are company-level and on reported earnings; consensus growth is on an adjusted basis. Basis differs by company (TTM for one, FY2025 for the rest) and is carried per row.
datasets.refresh: manual — re-pull via the Bigdata.com connector; not on the cron

datasets.source: Eurostat nasa_10_nf_tr — gross national income (B5G), total economy
datasets.note: GNI minus GDP is net primary income from abroad: negative where foreign-owned profits are repatriated out, positive where a country's firms earn abroad. B5G is a balance, so the PAID and RECV keys carry the same figure; read either

datasets.source: Eurostat national accounts A*64 — total gross value added, current prices, million national currency
datasets.note: the like-for-like denominator. GDP = GVA + taxes less subsidies on products, so pharma/GVA is the cleaner share; pharma/GDP is the more quotable one.

datasets.source: FAOSTAT cattle stocks (head), via Our World in Data
datasets.note: annual; national totals, all cattle

datasets.source: FAOSTAT cattle stocks (head) by EU member state, via Our World in Data
datasets.note: dairy and beef combined, same limitation as the aggregate

datasets.source: HS6 detail by reporter — establishes where detailed codes are published vs suppressed
datasets.unit: trade value in EUR; this file is a probe of what the source publishes, not a series to quote

datasets.source: probe: does Comext serve HS 6-digit detail?
datasets.note: No script writes this file and it is not in data-sources.json. Provenance unknown — verify or remove.

datasets.source: probe: which 3004 sub-codes Comext serves
datasets.note: No script writes this file and it is not in data-sources.json. Provenance unknown — verify or remove.

datasets.source: IMF World Economic Outlook via the IMF Data API (latest release), 30 economies: real GDP growth (NGDP_RPCH), inflation average and end-period (PCPIPCH, PCPIEPCH), unemployment (LUR), government gross debt and net lending % GDP (GGXWDG_NGDP, GGXCNL_NGDP), current account % GDP (BCA_NGDPD), GDP per capita and GDP in USD (NGDPDPC, NGDPD), investment and saving % GDP (NID_NGDP, NGSD_NGDP)
datasets.note: Series keys are country|indicator. Actuals through the release's last actual year, IMF projections after it (usually five years ahead); the two are not distinguished in the file, so treat the last five or six years as forecasts. Percent for rates, USD (full dollars, not billions) for NGDPD, USD for NGDPDPC

units.NGDP_RPCH: percent change on a year earlier
units.PCPIPCH: percent change on a year earlier, period average
units.PCPIEPCH: percent change on a year earlier, end of period
units.NGDPD: current US dollars (full dollars, not billions)

datasets.source: Eurostat lc_lci_r2_q — labour cost index, industry (B-E), quarterly, 2020=100, seasonally and calendar adjusted, total labour cost
datasets.note: Feeds the cost-escalation tool. SCA chosen so arbitrary quarter-to-quarter windows are not distorted by bonus seasonality — stated on the tool.
No script writes this file and it is not in data-sources.json. Provenance unknown — verify or remove.

datasets.source: TARSİM annual reports (Türkiye), USDA RMA (USA) and ENESA (Spain) livestock insurance statistics

datasets.note: No script writes this file and it is not in data-sources.json. Provenance unknown — verify or remove.

datasets.source: World Bank World Development Indicators: trade balance, current account, exports and imports, reserves, external debt, broad money, FDI, remittances and the real effective exchange rate, 30 economies
datasets.note: Series keys are country|indicator. Annual, and the World Bank lags one to two years; external debt is reported only by low and middle income countries, so it is empty for the advanced economies here. Government debt is not here: the WDI series is central government only and covers a third of these countries in odd years; use imf-weo GGXWDG_NGDP for general government gross debt. Broad money is missing for euro-area members (the ECB reports it for the area) and the REER for Türkiye

datasets.source: Eurostat national accounts A*64 — total manufacturing (NACE C) gross value added, current prices, million national currency
datasets.note: context denominator: pharma's share of manufacturing, not just of the whole economy

datasets.source: Eurostat HICP monthly index (2015=100): CP00 all items, CP011 food, CP0112 meat
